description: This file defines the `LookupTableChoices` class, a subclass of `InductorChoices`, responsible for handling lookup table-based configuration selection within PyTorch's inductor backend. It includes methods for generating lookup keys based on kernel inputs and device properties, validating template configurations via hash checks, and integrating lookup table results into kernel configuration choices.

classes.name: LookupTableChoices
classes.description: A class that manages lookup table-based kernel configuration choices, supporting key generation, validation, and overriding of default behavior for use in the PyTorch inductor backend.

methods.name: dict[str,list[dict[str,Any]]] _get_lookup_table(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the lookup table from the configuration if CUDA is available and the table is set.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_device_key(device: torch.device)
methods.description: Generates a device-specific key for lookup, based on CUDA device properties, or returns None for non-CUDA devices.

methods.name: str _generate_kernel_inputs_key(kernel_inputs: KernelInputs)
methods.description: Creates a unique string key from kernel input types, shapes, strides, and scalars to identify kernel configurations.

methods.name: Optional[str] make_lookup_key( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, op_name: str, include_device: bool = False )
methods.description: Constructs a lookup key combining device info (if included), kernel input info, and operation name.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] make_lookup_key_variants( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, op_name: str )
methods.description: Returns both device-specific and device-agnostic lookup keys for a given kernel input and operation.

methods.name: bool _entry_is_valid( cfg: dict[str, Any], template_id: str, template_hash_map: Optional[dict[str, Optional[str]]], )
methods.description: Validates a template configuration entry against hash checks, ensuring configuration consistency.

methods.name: dict[str,list[dict[str,Any]]] lookup_template_configs( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, op_name: str, template_uids: list[str], template_hash_map: Optional[dict[str, Optional[str]]] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves template configurations from the lookup table based on generated keys, filtering by hash validation.

methods.name: list[KernelTemplateChoice] _finalize_template_configs( self, template_choices: dict[str, Generator[KernelTemplateChoice, None, None]], kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, templates: list[Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice]], op_name: str, kwarg_overrides: Optional[dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Attempts to use lookup table results for kernel choices; falls back to parent if no matches.

methods.name: list[KernelTemplateChoice] _fallback( self, template_choices: dict[str, Generator[KernelTemplateChoice, None, None]], kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, templates: list[Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice]], op_name: str, kwarg_overrides: Optional[dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Fallback method to parent class's implementation if lookup table misses.

methods.name: list[KernelTemplateChoice] _create_lookup_choices( self, lookup_results: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]], templates: list[Union[KernelTemplate, ExternKernelChoice]], kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, op_name: str, )
methods.description: Creates KernelTemplateChoices from lookup results, combining with base template choices.
